country.name: Paraguay
country.languagePolicy: Spanish and Guaraní are official languages. The learner's first official language, bilingual education model, Indigenous language and community context must be reviewed; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Paraguayan reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible national, departmental, institutional, linguistic or community authority.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministerio de Educación y Ciencias governs national school education through central and territorial structures. Higher education has distinct legal actors: CONES registers and enables institutions, careers, programs, campuses and modalities within its remit; ANEAES evaluates and accredits quality; legally created universities retain their own academic governance subject to applicable law.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the institution and establishment identifiers, name, management sector, level or modality, department, district, locality, zone, offered services, data reference year, publication date and review date.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Legal creation, CONES institutional or academic-offer habilitation, campus and modality approval, degree authority, and ANEAES institutional, career or program accreditation are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación y Ciencias (MEC)
authorities.role: national school-education authority, curriculum, institution records and education statistics

authorities.name: Direcciones Departamentales de Educación and Supervisiones Educativas
authorities.role: territorial implementation and oversight within MEC governance

authorities.name: Consejo Nacional de Educación Superior (CONES)
authorities.role: higher-education governance, institutional and academic-offer habilitation and official registers within its legal remit

authorities.name: Agencia Nacional de Evaluación y Acreditación de la Educación Superior (ANEAES)
authorities.role: evaluation and accreditation of higher-education institutions, careers and programs

authorities.name: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación (MITIC)
authorities.role: host ministry for the data-protection authority created by Law 7593/2025

authorities.name: Ministerio de la Niñez y la Adolescencia
authorities.role: national child and adolescent protection authority within its legal remit

authorities.name: Dirección General de Educación Escolar Indígena
authorities.role: education policy and implementation for Indigenous peoples with community participation

curriculum.title: Current national curriculum, study programs and implementation guidance by level and modality
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm level, cycle, grade, subject, modality, governing resolution, document version, effective school year, bilingual model, first language and applicable Indigenous or local curriculum before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never silently replace current MEC curriculum and programs, bilingual-education requirements, approved institutional planning or community-governed Indigenous education.

schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Directorio de Instituciones and Datos Específicos de Instituciones Educativas
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The published directory page shows an October 2019 modification date. A directory or open-data record does not by itself prove current operation, authorization of every level or modality, or a current academic offer.

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display reference year, publication or update date, measure, population, education level or modality, geography, management sector, source and filters. Historical open-data sets must not be presented as current counts.

higherEducation.accreditationAuthority: Agencia Nacional de Evaluación y Acreditación de la Educación Superior
higherEducation.authorityNotice: A university's legal creation, CONES habilitation of an institution or a specific career or program by campus and modality, degree authority, and ANEAES institutional, career or program accreditation with a resolution and validity period are distinct. Admission to an evaluation process is not accreditation.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Ley N.º 7593/2025 de Protección de Datos Personales en la República del Paraguay
privacyAndSafeguarding.authorityStatus: The law creates the Agencia Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales within MITIC; its operational status, implementing decree, transition periods and applicable guidance must be confirmed before processing real learner data.
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Ley N.º 1680, Código de la Niñez y la Adolescencia, as amended
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Lawful basis, transparency, child-specific protections, consent or authorization where applicable, security, data-subject rights, impact assessment, incident handling and institution-specific safeguarding protocols require qualified Paraguayan review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Spanish and Guaraní official-language requirements, the learner's first official language and the applicable bilingual model must be reviewed. Indigenous education is people-, community-, territory-, culture- and language-specific; Guaraní must not be treated as a substitute for all Indigenous languages, and community participation cannot be replaced by automatic translation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Paraguayan education reviewer is named.
MEC, territorial, CONES, ANEAES, university, data-protection and child-protection responsibilities are correctly assigned.
Every institution record preserves identifiers, management sector, level or modality, geography, services, reference year, publication date and review date.
Historical directory and open-data records are not presented as current operation or current authorization.
Every statistic shows reference year, update date, definition, population, geography, management sector, filters and provenance.
Every higher-education claim distinguishes legal creation, CONES habilitation, offer, campus, modality, degree authority and ANEAES accreditation scope and validity.
Curriculum mappings identify level, cycle, grade, subject, modality, resolution, version, effective year and bilingual or Indigenous context.
Spanish, Guaraní and applicable Indigenous-language requirements are reviewed with competent institutions and affected communities.
Law 7593/2025 commencement, implementing regulation, authority operations and transition requirements are confirmed by qualified counsel.
Privacy, child safeguarding, accessibility, incident and authorization procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
